question.instructions: Does the candidate evidence contain a rule, exception or fact applicable to the current user need in the observed conversation?

state: exact input_text, original English, no summary/truncation/future/gold
tokenization: timed separately and included in request latency
timing: device synchronize, includes native CPU head/readout
memory: fresh sequential subprocess; total-process RSS peak and backend allocator/driver bytes separately; unified values not summed
quality_scope: descriptive agreement on existing train cards; not held-out or end-to-end agent improvement
uncertain: predict, exclude only from binary quality denominator; retain raw
failure: keep individual failures/overflow, report per-arm coverage and common cohort; do not retune thresholds/window/weights
